name: Snakes & Ladders
summary: Snakes & Ladders is a turn-based race board game played in a web browser on the Boardit site, for two to eight players who join one table with a short room code, each on their own phone or computer. Players throw one die per turn and move along a numbered board towards square 100. Landing on the foot of a ladder carries a piece up it, and landing on a snake slides it back down. A six gives no extra throw or bonus move. Square 100 must be reached by an exact roll; a throw that is too high leaves the piece where it is. Each turn is timed, and when the clock runs out the table throws for the player, so nobody can stall the game. There are no computer opponents.
